g.text: Declarative Library models and functional projection

text.tspan: Existing contracts and checked method binding
False signature / strength / incomplete input still refuse
Strict policy derives new obligation + pending
No checked witness -> no support or permission
Selected sorted rows -> pure part / edge / section fragments
One SysML string; acquisition and publication stay separate
FD01-FD05 actual receiver, cache and mapping controls
Default metadata / ordered facts / renderer compatibility probes
Capture, currentness, receipts and actual use checks
No new object system, DSL or workflow runner
Identity, inputs and premises follow receiver
One case inventory supplies native and SI/TM facts
